_ghi_chu: 6 giá trị Tôn Đổi Đồng Chí Gương Sáng. Tên tiếng Anh là TẠM (draft) — chờ HR xác nhận bản chính thức. 'active': ô có cách đạt trong bản hiện tại (zone 1–4: Respect, Fairness, Teamwork, Role Model, Innovation; Wisdom ở zone 5 chưa làm). Chữ hiển thị theo mã ngôn ngữ ('en'; sau thêm 'vi').

badge.name: Tôn Đổi Đồng Chí Gương Sáng

subtitle.en: FPT's six core values. Each slot lights up when you act in that spirit today.

how.en: Thank the bus driver and let others get off first.

hint.en: Small courtesies count — like thanking the bus driver.

how.en: Set an extra learning goal of your own in the FSA room.

hint.en: Try setting a learning goal beyond the suggested path.

how.en: Message Ms. Nga in the app when Tú's card turns red.

hint.en: When a friend is stuck, find the right way to help.

how.en: Take the lost wallet to reception instead of leaving it.

hint.en: Found something that isn't yours? Hand it in.

how.en: Don't let a stranger follow you through the card gate; point them to reception.

hint.en: Security rules apply to everyone, even when it feels awkward.

how.en: Put your first-week tasks in a sensible order with the manager.
